summary: Verified 3 new features end-to-end (backend + frontend): (1) P&L amortization marker exposes amort_breakdown/amort_cogs_breakdown and UI shows orange '(Amortisasi)' label with 'amort: Rp X' sub-line on affected cards (Gaji Karyawan, Pajak PPh 23, Sewa Kantor). Executed the payment for period 2026-07 (unpaid, Rp 2,000,000): POST /api/hr/pph21/{payroll_id}/pay returned {ok:true, total_pph21:2000000, fixed_cost_id:...}, status flipped to 'paid', fixed_cost row created with category 'PPh21 Karyawan', account_code 6106, posting_type expense, cash_account_code 1101. UI expand row + pay modal (cash-account, expense-date, confirm-pay) all present.
